name: Buy box
what: The written criteria a deal must meet before it gets underwritten: property type, size, location, price, tenancy and return targets.

fields.label: Whose criteria
fields.definition: The sponsor, fund or capital partner whose criteria these are.

fields.label: Effective date
fields.definition: The date this version was adopted, so a screen can name the version it was checked against.

fields.label: Property types
fields.definition: The property types and subtypes the box accepts, and any it names as excluded.

fields.label: Markets
fields.definition: The metro areas, submarkets or radius the box accepts.

fields.label: Minimum building size
fields.definition: The smallest building area accepted; null for no minimum.

fields.label: Maximum building size
fields.definition: The largest building area accepted; null for no maximum.

fields.label: Minimum price
fields.definition: The lowest total price accepted; null for no minimum.

fields.label: Maximum price
fields.definition: The highest total price accepted; null for no maximum.

fields.label: Physical criteria
fields.definition: Building and site requirements such as year built, construction, clear height, loading, office share, parking or land coverage.

fields.label: Tenancy criteria
fields.definition: Requirements on occupancy, number of tenants, remaining lease term, tenant credit and expense structure.

fields.label: Return targets
fields.definition: Each return measure the box sets, such as going-in cap rate, levered IRR, equity multiple or cash-on-cash, with its target and whether it is levered.

fields.label: Leverage limits
fields.definition: The maximum loan-to-value or minimum coverage the box allows, and whether recourse is acceptable.

fields.label: Hold period
fields.definition: The intended range of years from purchase to sale.

fields.label: Firm criteria
fields.definition: The criteria the box treats as firm rather than preferences; a deal that fails one is shown as an exception at the top of the screen.

fields.label: Exclusions
fields.definition: Situations the box rules out regardless of the other criteria, such as ground leases, special-purpose buildings or known contamination.
